senses.gloss: (b. h.) Pethahia, name of a priest (and a priestly family) during the days of the Second Temple.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Shekalim 5:1">Shek. V, 1</cite> <he>פ׳ על הקינין</he> P. had the supervision of the sacrificial birds.
<cite ref="Mishnah Shekalim 5:1">Ib.</cite> <he>פ׳ זה מרדכי</he> P. is the same as Mordecai, v. <cite ref="Q02143"><he>פָּתַח</he></cite>; <cite ref="Menachot 65a:1">Men. 65ᵃ</cite>
